title: A name is trimmed and not blank
statement: A name MUST be trimmed of surrounding spaces and MUST NOT be blank.

title: An email address looks like an address
statement: An email address MUST look like `x@y.z`, with no spaces.

title: An email address is kept trimmed and in lower case
statement: An email address MUST be trimmed and kept in lower case, so two spellings of one address, differing only in case or surrounding spaces, are the same address.

title: A condition is good or needs repair
statement: A condition MUST be either `good` or `needs_repair`. The same two values are used for a tool and for a return.

title: A note is trimmed and not blank
statement: A note MUST be trimmed and MUST NOT be blank. Where a note is optional, a blank one is none.
